asker.description: Who asked, as the room knows them; the owner where none is named.

key.description: The depth: search:basic for one value or one fact, search:thorough for a question with a few angles, search:exhaustive for a deep dive, browse for a task that must open and click through pages.

model.description: The model, only where the owner named one for this research; left out otherwise.

options.description: Options for the search, such as brief, a table or the full document.

provider.description: The provider the named model stands on, where one is meant.

query.description: The question, written whole as the owner means it.

roomId.description: The room the result comes back to: the room this turn answers.
